sources.title: Cipher Digital Begins Development of Lateral Pipelines to Facilitate Data Center Expansion via Bring-Your-Own-Generation
sources.notes: Company announcement and forward-looking statement. The 2.5 GW is generation capacity, not measured operational IT load.

record.scope: Multiple Cipher U.S. HPC data-center sites
record.claim: Cipher says lateral pipelines under development could support up to 2.5 GW of on-site natural-gas generation before the end of 2027 for additional leasable HPC capacity.
record.caveat: Generation nameplate is not IT power, the tenant and Personal-AI allocation are unknown, and the timing is forward-looking. Excluded from the direct U.S. operational IT-power path.
